source_text: Moyses imponit manus Iesu Nave; spiritus in eo est. Successor ducit populum. Gloria in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Moses places hands on Jesus of-Nun; spirit in him is. Successor leads people. Glory into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Moses lays hands on Joshua; the spirit is in him >> Bible:Numbers 27:18-23]]. The successor will lead the people. Glory forever. Amen.
